structure_plan.overview: Brick-built minifig-style Jedi in white outfit with yellow hair, holding a blue lightsaber; blocky 6w x 4d footprint on a small stand.

subassemblies.name: Stand
subassemblies.description: Low LightBluishGray platform to stabilize the statue (approx. 6x6 studs).

subassemblies.name: Legs
subassemblies.description: White block legs with slight foot overhang at front.

subassemblies.name: Torso + Arms
subassemblies.description: White torso with red belt stripe; arms brought forward to center to hold saber.

subassemblies.name: Head + Hair
subassemblies.description: White head with front-stud eyes/mouth; yellow block hair cap.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber
subassemblies.description: LBG/DBG hilt with stacked blue round bricks for blade.

step_outline.title: Stand base (layer 1)
step_outline.description: Build a 6x6 plate footprint in LightBluishGray using 2x4 (3020) + 2x2 (3022) + 1x2 (3023) plates as needed; keep edges squared.

step_outline.title: Stand base (layer 2)
step_outline.description: Add a second LightBluishGray plate layer, stagger seams vs. layer 1 for strength (same overall 6x6).

step_outline.title: Legs (core)
step_outline.description: Center on stand: place two White 2x2 bricks (3003) side-by-side to form a 4w x 2d block; stack to 3 bricks tall total.

step_outline.title: Feet detail
step_outline.description: On the front of each leg, add one White 1x2 brick (3004) at the lowest level to create a small toe overhang (one per leg).

step_outline.title: Hips / lower torso
step_outline.description: On top of legs, make a 4w x 2d White layer using one White 2x4 brick (3001) (or two 2x2 bricks if needed).

step_outline.title: Torso core
step_outline.description: Stack 2 more White brick layers (4w x 2d) using White 2x4 (3001) / 2x2 (3003) to reach chest height.

step_outline.title: Arms forward pose
step_outline.description: Left and right sides of torso: attach White 1x2 bricks (3004) to bring total width to ~6 studs; extend each arm 1 stud forward at chest height using White plates (3023/3024) so both hands meet near center front.

step_outline.title: Belt accent
step_outline.description: Add a Red 1x2 tile (3069b) (or Red 1x2 plate 3023 if tiles run out) centered on the front of the torso at waist height.

step_outline.title: Head block (with face studs)
step_outline.description: Build a 4w x 2d x 2h head in White. On the front face, use two White 1x1 bricks w/ stud on 1 side (87087) oriented with studs facing forward; attach Black round tiles (98138) as eyes. Add a Black (or Red) round tile (98138) centered below as mouth/chin detail.

step_outline.title: Hair cap
step_outline.description: Top the head with a Yellow hair block: one Yellow 2x4 plate (3020) or 2x3 (3021) as the crown, then add Yellow 2x2/1x2 plates (3022/3023) around edges to suggest layered hair.

step_outline.title: Lightsaber build
step_outline.description: Hilt: stack 2–3 LightBluishGray round bricks 1x1 (3062b) with a Black round tile (98138) as pommel. Blade: stack 4–6 Blue round bricks 1x1 (3062b) on top; cap with TransClear round tile (98138) as tip.

step_outline.title: Mount lightsaber to hands
step_outline.description: Attach the hilt to the center-front between the arms (use a White 1x1 brick w/ stud on 1 side (87087) or a front-facing 1x2 SNOT brick (3660) embedded in torso if needed). Adjust arm plates so the saber reads as held in both hands.

notes: Color limitation: no tan/light-nougat available; head is White with Yellow hair to match silhouette.
If you need a stronger front mount for the saber: replace a front torso brick with White 1x2 brick w/ stud on side (3660) oriented forward.
If Blue 3062b quantity is short, alternate blade segments with TransClear 3062b to keep the tall lightsaber look.
Keep overall proportions: stand 6x6, legs 4w, torso widens to ~6w with arms, head 4w, saber held centered and angled slightly upward.
